{{Quote|We're paying a visit to my old friend, Professor Smith.|[[Jann Tosh]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="SD" />}}
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Akary Smith''' was an academic who worked aboard a [[communications satellite]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. He was friends with [[Gar Tosh]] since his childhood. His friendship also extended to Gar Tosh's son, [[Jann Tosh]], of whom Jann developed a bond with.

At one point, [[XR]], the professor's personal [[Droid/Legends|droid]], was reprogrammed and armed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] so that the general could take Smith, Jann, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] as prisoners.<ref name="SD" />
